name: rating
behavior: APG radio group pattern: one radio input per item sharing a group name; arrow keys move and select, Space selects the focused item; the group is labelled via aria-label/aria-labelledby and announces read-only via aria-readonly; each item announces its value ('<n> of <max>')

parts.statesNote: filled items (value <= shown value) use action color with filled icon-style; empty items use content-secondary outline

parts.note: the glyph is supplied by the CONSUMER — the contract's semantic icon role list has no 'rating' role, deliberately: the choice of star/heart/etc. is product voice, not system character. The filled-vs-outline swap is a recipe on the item, not a role mapping.
optional visible value label, e.g. '3 of 5'

anatomyNotes: hover is a PREVIEW: hovering item N shows items 1..N filled (the prospective value) until the pointer leaves; items between a lower previewed value and a higher current selection render empty ('unselecting'). readonly: no hover preview, no cursor-interactive, value still announced. Salt's radio-input mechanics carry over as behavior; its specific star glyphs and dedicated unselecting icon are character and stay in the Salt adapter.
